_comment: Merge into the USER-level ~/.claude/settings.json, not a project's.
One copy of board_hook.py in ~/.claude/hooks covers every project;
nothing is copied per project. $HOME is filled in by the shell that
Claude Code runs hook commands through, so leave it as it is.
Set BOARD_URL to your board's address: https:// and the hostname, with
no /mcp on the end. SETUP.md step 13 walks through it.
The board key is deliberately absent: it is a credential and settings
files get committed. It lives in ~/.config/claude-noticeboard/token.
BOARD_TOPIC is absent too, so each project's channel is its folder
name. Set it per project only to override that.
